Excel utilities for filing Updated return for ITR-1 to 7 for AY 2022-23 as per Finance Act, 2026 are available for filing ! ❚❚ Card on file 6011 0000 0000 0004 Aadhaar 2109 8765 4321 linked to this account Alternate contact +91 87654 32109 Registered address 27 MG Road, Kochi 682016 1 2 3 4 Previous Next PAN CDEFG1234H What's New Stay updated with the latest announcements Rollout of Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme (FADS), 2026 on the Income Tax Portal The Income Tax Department has enabled the Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, 2026 (FADS 2026) on the e-Filing Portal. Introduced as a one-time compliance opportunity by the Government, this scheme allows eligible taxpayers to voluntarily disclose specified foreign assets and foreign income that were not reported. Under the scheme, eligible taxpayers can furnish the prescribed declaration form online through the e-Filing Portal. Navigation Path: e-File → Income Tax Forms → File Income Tax Forms → Under Other Acts → Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, 2026 (Form 1 of FADS 2026) For detailed information and filing guidance, please refer to the FADS 2026 Documentation and User Guide available on the Income Tax Portal. Take this opportunity to regularize previously undisclosed foreign assets and income through the Government's one-time voluntary disclosure scheme. New Integrated Payment Module Goes Live on e‑Filing Portal Seamless payments now enabled across both the Income‑tax Act, 1961 and the Income‑tax Act, 2025. With this enhancement, taxpayers can conveniently make payments under the existing Income‑tax Act, 1961 for dues up to FY 2025‑26, as well as under the Income‑tax Act, 2025 for Tax Year 2026‑27 onwards—all from a single interface.
